Create a cinematic fantasy practice-duel scene using @Video1 as the sole coarse 3D motion and camera reference. Follow its sixteen-second exchange and camera progression. Carina is the fifteen-year-old pale-blond girl in a white collar, green-and-silver Slytherin tie, charcoal knitwear, open dark robe, charcoal skirt, grey knee socks and closed black shoes. Harry is the fifteen-year-old dark-haired boy with round glasses, white collar, burgundy-and-gold Gryffindor tie, charcoal knitwear, open dark robe, charcoal trousers and closed black shoes. Both keep their own dark wooden wands in their right hands throughout.

Harry steps within Carina's wand reach. Their real wooden wands meet; his left hand takes her right wrist clear of the cuff. Preserve the held material contact while she bends that elbow, raises their joined hands above her head and steps beneath the hold. Her body turns beneath the raised arm and her wand points safely out from the pair. Harry follows partway, then opens his fingers before her shoulder is pulled. She completes the turn and faces him. Preserve his two quick supported backward diagonal steps and recovery beneath the projecting cap, with his left hand free again.

Keep both feet and the held wrist readable in the shared moving view. Then preserve Carina's blue-white shot, Harry's actual wand sweep, the bend at his wand tip and the resulting strike on the cracked lower mortar. The streak ends at that joint. Exactly two small chips follow; the upright and one main cap remain present. The spell must not replace the physical exchange.

Keep the same pale daylight, grey court, low boundary, bare surrounding ground and finite population. Use natural human proportions while retaining the reference's support, release and possession relationships. There is no new dialogue or added caption in this clip. Keep audio silent. This is semantic reference guidance, not strict frame locking.
